modmenu.descriptionTranslation.cobblemon: Applies client defaults once or on every launch before the game initializes.
screen.cobblemon_client_defaults.title: Client Defaults
screen.cobblemon_client_defaults.descrip: Defaults: apply CLC HUD and Xaero settings every launch; clean up keys once. Saved modes take effect on the next launch.
screen.cobblemon_client_defaults.keybind: Unbinds the CLC HUD toggle, Talking Heads toggle, voice chat icon toggle, Zoomify secondary zoom, and Crafting Tweaks compress/refill keys. Crafting Tweaks uses buttons only. Once mode preserves later personal settings.
screen.cobblemon_client_defaults.xaero_h: Disables waypoints, deathpoints and map teleport; always shows icons; binds map/settings to J/Y. Activates the dedicated icon pack if installed. The server policy blocks waypoint creation menus.
screen.cobblemon_client_defaults.clc_mis: Cobbled Level Control is not installed.
screen.cobblemon_client_defaults.read_fa: Could not read client defaults. Check client.toml and the game log.
screen.cobblemon_client_defaults.save_fa: Could not save. Check the game log.
screen.cobblemon_client_defaults.saved: Saved. The selected mode takes effect on the next game launch.
